incident-bot: PagerDuty page fired: INC-4521 — inference-queue backlog > 5000 (us-east-1). Severity: P1. Link: https://pagerduty.local/incidents/INC-4521

chloe: acked INC-4521 @pagerduty-bot — taking a look. seeing sustained queue depth and rising 5xxs.

raj: oncall here, taking lead. any immediate customer impact?

chloe: a handful of customers reporting timeouts, overall hosted-api p50 latency +3.5s, error rate ~1.8%. dashboard snapshot below.

chloe: ```
metric: inference_queue_depth_us_east = 5124
metric: hosted_api_5xx_rate = 1.8%
metric: hosted_api_p50_latency = 3.5s
metric: autoscaler_last_scale = 12m ago
logs: autoscaler-controller error: failed to allocate node: quota_exceeded
```

emily: I can try a couple of mitigations: manual spin-up of dedicated pool and shift a fraction of traffic to us-west fallback. starting manual actions now.

raj: runbook step: try manual scaleup: `kubectl scale deploy/autoscaler-pool --replicas=6 -n inference`
raj: result: `Error: quota exceeded: requested nodes would exceed resource quota` — looks like cloud quota blocking scale.

chloe: pinging infra for emergency quota bump, but that may take 15-30m. for immediate relief can we shift traffic? @emily can you start a gradual route-shift?

emily: initiating traffic shift to us-west 10% -> command: `traffic-shift --service=inference --from=us-east-1 --to=us-west-2 --pct=10` — starting now.

incident-bot: PagerDuty: INC-4521 acknowledged by chloe

pagerduty-bot: Escalation notice: INC-4521 forwarded to oncall-2 (raj) after 5m no-resolve

chloe: drafting short customer comms (status page + targeted DM for affected accounts). cc @raj for ops notes.

raj: infra on call replied: quota bump request submitted, ETA ~20m. continuing routing. @emily increase to 40% if metrics look stable.

emily: updated traffic shift to 40%. monitoring metrics — hosted_api_5xx_rate -> 0.6%, queue_depth -> 2100 and trending down.

chloe: nice progress. FYI KV cache warmups on new nodes are causing transient latency spikes — small blips but overall errors decreasing.

raj: mitigation plan going forward: 1) keep traffic shifted until backlog < 500; 2) enable temporary batching cap to reduce per-request latency (set BATCH_MAX=8); 3) follow up with infra for permanent quota increase and autoscaler tuning.

emily: applied env change `BATCH_MAX=8` on staging then prod via canary. no obvious regressions so far.

incident-bot: INC-4521 mitigation applied, monitoring for stability. Will mark resolved when SLOs stable for 15m.

chloe: assigning postmortem roles: chloe = PM/owner, raj = infra/autoscaler investigation, emily = traffic/routing and infra follow-up. :white_check_mark:

chloe: short note for postmortem — observed autoscaler stuck due to cloud node quota error; need alert for 'scale blocked by quota' and fallback automation to shift traffic automatically.

raj: agreed. adding ➕ automation ticket after incident.

emily: metrics stabilizing — p50 back to normal, error rate ~0.2%, queue depth ~120.

chloe: closing the PD after 18m of stable SLOs. thanks team. :heart:
